Phase 16 – Go-To-Market Execution & Demand Capture

Objective: Turn the finished system (services, pilots, pricing, governance, AI stack) into controlled, scalable demand without overselling or chaos.

16.1 GTM Operating Principle (Read This First)

DTM does not “launch everywhere”.

DTM:

Opens controlled demand valves

Validates signal → expands

Closes channels when quality drops

This phase is about execution discipline, not growth hype.

16.2 Primary Demand Channels (What We ACTUALLY Use)
Channel Priority Order (Do not invert)

Pilot-Led Inbound (Highest Intent)

Outbound Precision (Founder / Decision Maker only)

Partnerships & White-Label

Paid Media (Used surgically, not broadly)

Anything else is optional and experimental.
